94.Name: Texas1
94.Text: Two identical cards can be combined to be upgraded, resulting in the combined card's level becoming the sum of the two initial cards.

95.Name: Texas2
95.Text: When a player has 3 or more cards from the same Faction or Class in hand, union effects for these cards will become active.

96.Name: Texas3
96.Text: Each time a card is selected, the remaining cards in central deck are increased by 1 level.

97.Name: Texas4
97.Text: Cards within the central deck will be automatically destroyed when they are raised from level 6 to level 7.

98.Name: Texas5
98.Text: When selecting a formation, Relics will automatically take effect, and do not need to be selected.

99.Name: Texas6
99.Text: Once heroes have been selected, adjust their formation before commencing battle.
